description_en: Modifies the public network access control policy at the office network or cloud computer granularity
description_zh: 修改办公网络或云电脑粒度上的公网访问控制策略
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-acl-entries --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --source-type desktop --source-id ecd-afhjuiwhfia000 --policy allow --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAclEntries

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The granularity of the public network access control policy
parameters.help_zh: 公网访问控制策略对应的粒度
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The list of instance IDs for public network access control, which are office network IDs or cloud computer IDs
parameters.help_zh: 公网访问控制对应的实例ID列表，即办公网络ID列表或云电脑ID列表
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.help_en: The public network access control policy
parameters.name: policy
